# ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder

ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder is a local-first governed AI build-and-memory system for training small language-model candidates, benchmarking them, promoting only non-regressing winners, and preserving receipts, lineage, rollback bundles, and dataset provenance.

Important current state:
- Current reproducible incumbent: arc_governed_v10_wave4 at 0.9237 on the audited v10 path.
- v11.3/wave5 is candidate/staging only.
- External datasets are acquisition targets only, not bundled or promoted.
- ARC Language Module carries the current lexical/provenance knowledge spine.
- Omnibinary + Arc-RAR provide archive, replay, restore, and device-portable communication.
- ARC-StreamMemory is an add-on for visual/video memory for all LLMs and ARC-style systems.
- Roadmap: 3.0 protected dataset/model/licensing integration; 4.0 ProtoSynth / Neural Synth projection; 5.0 Portal-style companion mockup; 7.0 working Synth AI companion and buildable brain lab.


## Next integration graph

ARC-Neuron now documents the next integration graph: current v10 incumbent -> 3.0 protected dataset/license/v2-candidate integration -> 4.0 ProtoSynth/Neural Synth spatial projection with ARC-StreamMemory visual memory add-on -> 5.0 Portal-style Synth companion mockup -> 7.0 working Synth AI companion / AGI assistant / buildable brain lab. These future layers are add-ons/interfaces and do not bypass Gate v2 or incumbent protection.
